The problem with this course is that a topic such as an entire programming language cannot ever be learned in such a short time. So, what ends up happening is we learn everything inadequately and forget what little we have learned in a few months anyway. The same thing happened with Photoshop classes, the same thing happened with the HTML classes. I really feel that COMD either should go ALL the way and teach them all properly or focus on ONE of these and teach that properly, not whatever this is right now. Because I do agree we should at LEAST learn the adobe programs we will use as designers 7/24, it's just that this way we do not learn anything properly anyway so why bother?
For people who are not interested in coding, it might be challenging.
